scope: Whole independent TypeScript owner authored from exactly the six frozen public format packet files, preserving existing public ports and fixed output data.
status: Authored and manually reviewed only; both allocated outputs frozen with mode 0444 before curator body review.

files.sha256Location: Full final UTF-8 file SHA256 is calculated in memory and reported in the author final response. Embedding its own full-file digest would be self-referential.

accounting.readDefinition: Each complete read_bytes call is one file read. Output printed to the model was manually reviewed and is not an additional filesystem read.
accounting.lineDefinition: len(bytes.splitlines()); both authored outputs end in a newline.
accounting.hashDefinition: SHA256 of full exact file bytes. Input and source hashes were calculated at each read/write. Receipt hash is calculated from the final serialized bytes in memory and reported externally.
accounting.receiptSerialization: Metadata stabilization happens solely in memory before the single receipt write. No accounting file, receipt read, or superseded output write.
accounting.metadataOperations: mkdir of the allocated output directory and chmod of the two allocated outputs do not read or alter file contents. No directory enumeration or other file access was performed.

reasoningFromContract: Call the imported schema safeParse once as its receiver method with the exact supplied output; failure returns the fixed invalid-result text. Successful projection uses parsed.data and never changes supplied objects.
Use exact imported modules, names and type-only identities. Imported schema, time, escaping, attribute, roster, provider and artifact policies remain opaque and are consumed rather than implemented.

Append summary, each identity/lifecycle block, pending questions, health, optional phases including empty text, subagents, log tail, usage, outcome and routing in contract order, separated by two newlines.

Use generatedAt as the sole time basis; preserve nullish actor-name fallback and age fallback, empty optional strings, raw result, numeric usage values, artifact order, and the exact helper argument references.

Route superseded stop reason before status; otherwise stopped receives the fixed resumable block and every status receives amendable. The healthy-running short branch requires stalledSince to be undefined, including treating zero as present.

Required prose, XML, punctuation, backticks, separators and template fragments are source-derived fixed preservation material, not novel author expression. Full paragraphs use single spaces and script paths receive separate original escaping calls.
No catches, new clocks, runtime port substitutes, normalization, truncation, schema reconstruction, actual workflows, agents, files, network or user data were added to formatter behavior.

manualReview.reviewed: Read the complete authored source once and manually checked API/imports, output text and separators, block/port order, optional value presence, identity forwarding, routing and synchronous propagation against the six displayed packet inputs.
manualReview.unverified: No runtime equivalence or compilability claim; safeParse availability and all imported policy behavior remain actual-owner dependencies.

exposureAndClaims.authorInputs: Only the six named frozen public packet files were read from disk; their source-derived declarations, schema metadata and required fixed data are acknowledged exposure.
exposureAndClaims.excludedReads: No predecessor source, source history, tests, other packets, actual dependency bodies, broad environment, repository or user-data reads.
exposureAndClaims.context: The task instructions and packet note source-exposed curator, historical exposure and a repaired breach. These contextual qualifications are retained; this author did not investigate or independently verify them.
exposureAndClaims.executor: Shared executor with instruction-only restrictions and author self-report; no OS isolation, enforced independence, independent access audit or proof of non-exposure is claimed.
exposureAndClaims.rights: No originality, novelty, copyright, licensing, legal clearance or rights conclusion is claimed for fixed source-derived material or the authored whole.
exposureAndClaims.savedFast: Unchanged and unverified; no measurement, benchmark or savedFast inspection was performed.

handoff.curator: Archive and commit the complete source and receipt before body review. Any later real correction must be a complete same-author replacement with a full cumulative receipt, not a curator patch.
handoff.remaining: Manual-only artifact; curator archival/commit and any authorized later checks are outside this author turn.
